subject.title: fix: stop model catalog warning loop during sidecar refresh

question: Is deterministic fs-safe boundary proof plus the hosted proof check enough for this production Anthropic/systemd warning-loop fix, or should live authenticated gateway proof be required before merge?
rationale: The code-path fix and tests match the identified race, but the original report was a live daemon/provider symptom and the PR explicitly did not run that full reproduction.

options.title: Accept deterministic boundary proof
options.body: Proceed with normal exact-head merge review because the patch covers the implicated owner boundary and the hosted proof check passed.

options.title: Require live daemon proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Anthropic/systemd gateway run showing the warning loop stays quiet and the generated catalog sidecar appears.

recommendation.title: Accept deterministic boundary proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with normal exact-head merge review because the patch covers the implicated owner boundary and the hosted proof check passed.
